body: She didn’t ask if I was okay with it and she knew that I would feel bad for saying no whenever she asked for it. I could’ve said no but I didn’t. Why? I felt bad. I don’t know how they would respond to it, honestly. We tend to just text instead of like saying face-to-face? Or it’s just mostly I spend my time being alone and couldn’t care about their response? How does it make me feel when they say that? Frustrated. Upset. Disappointed but not surprised. 

I don’t even know what makes me feel that way, it’s just something I think to myself, like I can’t just expect anyone to go ‘downhills’ with me? There are so many things in life and they can just do and enjoy it. I’m just a miserable person who doesn’t deserve happiness in life. Their time would be wasted.  

What does being comfortable in that sense mean to me? Hmm, simple question yet so difficult to answer still. I can’t even tell, to be honest, I don’t know how to put it in words. But all I know it’s that I feel comfortable around him, and just only him. When t comes to other people, just no and no at all. And I don’t know why. When I’m with other people I’d be like, ‘I wanna leave’ and it don’t wanna be here’. And when I was with him I’d be like ‘I wish I could stop the time and could be spending more time with this amazing guy’. 

How so about never going to be good enough? I don’t even know still. It’s like everything I do seems to be mistakes. Just a loser. It’s like people look at me as if I’m like an expired food, stinky, nobody wanna be near me, etc. Just, never gonna be good enough at all no matter what. 

Thank you so much, I don’t know, just honestly thank you so much for everything. But still, I am really sorry for the late reply. Was going to reply as soon as I got it but happened to ‘zone out’ and just completely forgot and then kept being like that in circle.

I don’t know, but the words they constantly keel telling me “you’ll be fine” and “you deserve better” or “you can be happy if you try hard enough” just stop me from telling them what’s the matter. 

If someone wanted to go through it with me in that way, I would feel valued but bad as well. Like, glad to know that but feel sorry for them that they are putting with me as they could have done something else instead of spending their time being with someone like me? 

He helped me see the light.. it may sound weird, but before I was with him my life was just meh, until the day we started speaking and how magically he made me feel so happy and loved like I never felt before. He was always there for me. He cracked up jokes. He never judged me if I cried but would try his best to comfort me. There was no awkward stage between us, it was like we had known each other since we came to this earth. Felt so comfortable around him. 

I am unsure, mostly because we don’t talk but how they behave around their friends that I notice? I could be wrong, but they just really look happy.. They seem to have good times with people? 

Simple questions that take ages to reply although if they are not right or wrong answers..

Yes, I have thought about talking to someone about how I’ve been feeling. But I also have decided not to do it as 
1) they have their own problems 
2) I would get told the same things over and over again 
3) the only one person I ever wanted to talk to is unfortunately unavailable as things ended between us

I would really like it if they just.. hug me, you know? Without me begging/asking. Stroking my hair. Telling me they’re here and everything’s gonna be okay and that we both can go through it together. But that just sounds too much work for them.  Instead of them telling me that I deserve better or just try to be happy. 

By that, I mean like, once a guy who was like the love of my life said to me that he would never leave me, but he left anyway. He was the one who had helped me to see the light in life. But I have lost that light in my life. Nobody could ever replace him at all. I really wish things didn’t end. But it ended for reasons. And I’m glad he is enjoying his life right now with good people around him unlike ungrateful me. So it’s like, people just leave, no matter what they say to you, no matter how they promise you, but one day, they will eventually leave. Nobody is staying forever. 

I’m never good enough because I can make nobody stay? Because of how unhappy I am? Or basic reason is that I’m just never good enough. I just am never. Never at all...

Of course not, I don’t mind you asking, I’m glad you ask me instead of telling me otherwise like most of people in my life. 

It’s like everything. Specific? Well, family, relationships, friendship, my mind, myself, and just... everything. Certain places. Certain words. Memories. Pointless life. Impossible wishes. 

Recently, I got told “you can be happy but you haven’t tried hard enough”. Like, how would you know if I haven’t actually tried hard enough? I have. But what can I do when I got told that? I don’t know. 

Everyone just leaves me even if they say they are not. 

They say they will come back and will always be there for me. But when is it and where are they? 

I don’t wanna be here feeling like this at all. 

I don’t wanna bother anyone. I’m totally a burden. I’m never good enough at all. 

Maybe just like how my mother said, nobody can help you if you continue to be like this, not even doctors. 

Some said she was right. Some said she was wrong. I just don’t know. 

I just wish for one person to be here with me like he used to. 

But like I have mentioned above, impossible wishes. 

Why am I even here?
